components.construction: Upper far-side winding exit to the opposite leading spring tensioner. The front roll and near-side hardware obscure its forward section.
Inclined shaft to the far-side steering gear, hidden by the rear structure including all rear spoke openings.
Continuous frame from firebox to water tank; rivets only in observed rows.
Photographed flared water-box top, round lower corner, riveted seam and tow outlet.
Straight barrel edges and continuous flanged smokebox, regularised from the source photograph.
Source-visible drain, return loop and two pipe unions below the barrel.
One connected bedplate from cylinder flange to the crankshaft bearing; source-visible covers and fasteners.
Source-observed upper guide and valve linkage; joined supports and connected rods.
Actual rectangular cylinder cover, raised maker plate and bolted foot; no invented side section.
Paired valve columns, lever, valve block and drain cock read directly from the close source photo.
Observed small lever and oval inspection boss on the boiler; the coupling rod reaches its next bearing.
Aveling winged front casting from both photos; continuous upper/lower contours and rib.
Source-confirmed upward-widening chimney, rolled cap, bolted collar and continuous saddle pedestal.
Visible crank bearing, regulator lever and brake quadrant; all rods terminate in bearings or pins.
Solid disc and dished centre of 5499, distinguished from the spoked Fowler reference.
Shaped source housing on a bolted plate, axle boss, pipe and connected upper shaft.
Forward rear-wheel scraper from the user photograph: frame bearing, hinged arm, adjusting stay and tangential blade. Far scraper coincides in this projection.
Actual tank-side brake spindle and triangular scraper linkage; continuous pinned tie rod.
User-requested reduced spoke count with staggered inner spokes and deeper roller rims; source-fitted circular outlines retained. Count and inclinations are illustrative.
User-requested reduced spoke count with staggered inner spokes and deeper roller rims; source-fitted circular outlines retained. Count and inclinations are illustrative.
Observed pear-shaped drive plate with continuous tangent outline, axle cap and offset pin.
User-requested reduced spoke count with staggered inner spokes and deeper roller rims; source-fitted circular outlines retained. Count and inclinations are illustrative.
User-requested reduced spoke count with staggered inner spokes and deeper roller rims; source-fitted circular outlines retained. Count and inclinations are illustrative.
Shared vertical axis locks the source casting, swivel collars, fork and axle to one continuous joint.
Level beam and tangential scraper bracket, bolted to the fork; source-visible spring at leading edge.
Lower winding-gear exit to the leading front spring tensioner output eye. The old trailing-bracket eye is removed.

forward_rear_scraper.far_assembly: coincident and hidden in strict side projection

far_chain_occlusion.mask: complete front-roll silhouette, including drum behind spoke openings

far_chain_return_pipe_occlusion.mask: opaque material between existing tube walls; far chain hidden, near chain retained

steering_handwheel.projection: edge-on rim and hub profile perpendicular to shaft; no elliptical face

steering_column.hidden_by: foreground engine assemblies and complete rear-assembly silhouette

steering_chain_routes.front_attachment_projection: Matching spring connectors on opposite faces coincide in strict side elevation; the front roll hides the far attachment.

quadrant_release.shape: Longer open V with pivot farther down the main handle

wheel_spoke_arrangement.qualification: User-requested reduced counts: six front and ten rear spokes per set. Staggered inner detail is retained. Counts and hidden construction are illustrative, not asserted from surveyed geometry.

geometry.merl_role: drafting and composition reference only; not Aveling geometry
geometry.refinement: Axis-centred small fittings, exact circular bolt geometry, tangent spoke fillets, located steering-wheel support, centred brake handle, continuous pipe elbows and corrected local occlusion.

layout_override.request: single large side drawing, compact bottom strip, Invicta horse and enlarged worksplate in clear upper-right space

badge.plate_adaptation: GWRA No.6882 layout/oval reference, adapted to user-confirmed No.5499. Lettering redrawn for pen legibility.

metadata.merl_reference_role: Fowler S1021 composition and drafting language only; not a 5499 factory drawing
